interface.longDescription:
Find places in Vienna, see estimated taxi fares by vehicle type, and request, check or cancel a ride after signing in with your Taxi Wien App account. Taxi Wien App never handles fare payments: at the end of the ride you pay the driver directly in the car with the driver's payment methods, by credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or cash. Nothing is paid in ChatGPT. Estimates may vary with route, traffic and waiting time. Ride requests and cancellations require explicit confirmation. The app never asks for your location: you tell it where the ride starts and ends.

Website: https://taxiwien.app

name: taxi-wien-app
